snippet.title: CardBoard | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
CardBoard blends the chaotic fun of a party game with the deep strategy of a roguelike deckbuilder. Gather companions or brave it alone. Choose from a variety of characters with unique cards and dice, and battle across dynamic themed boards. No healer required—just a little faith in the cards.

Wishlist now @ https://store.steampowered.com/app/4085700/CardBoard

Follow my bluesky account for more and thanks so much for checking out my trailer.
